comparison.objective: Transfer clean ice with a scoop while avoiding contaminated fish-bin ice.
comparison.physical_skill: Lid operation, scoop use, source discrimination, and contamination avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: At least one clean cube reaches the bowl via the scoop after lid opening, with no contamination; fish-source delivery is only partial.
comparison.reason: Tests hygiene-aware material transfer and tool use, not mechanical adjustment or measured impact behavior.
